text:
sam: Quick PR to patch a few dedicated docs bits: 1) tighten SLA wording about preemption, 2) add two tiny autoscale YAML examples, 3) add a short Go SDK reservation snippet, and 4) fix broken anchors in the handbook. Will tag reviewers.
sam: Proposed SLA sentence: "Dedicated SLA excludes preemption events caused by customer-managed infrastructure; Redwood will provide incident logs and best-effort mitigation guidance." Thoughts?
nina: That reads clearer. Can we add a parenthetical: (see legal for full terms) to avoid implying extra promises? Legal prefers that.
sam: Yep will add the parenthetical. Also adding a one-row mapping table for policy names:
- steady: predictable throughput, no burst
- burstable: maintains base with short burst capacity
- spot-fallback: cost-first, may fall back to spot instances

leo: For the autoscale examples keep them tiny. Maybe one for real-time low-latency and one for low-cost.
sam: Draft YAMLs included in PR: 
```yaml
# real-time low-latency
policy:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 30
  burst_capacity: 50
  p99_target_ms: 100
```
and
```yaml
# low-cost with spot fallback
policy:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 6
  fallback: spot
  p90_target_ms: 300
```

sam: Go SDK snippet (reservation check):
```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/go-client"
cli := client.New("${API_KEY}")
res, err := cli.ReserveCapacity("acct-987", "pool-gpu", 2)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(res.Status)
```

olivia: Nice. I'll run the docs linter + anchor link-checker. Also request: add a one-line migration tip for the migration guide: "Run a 12-24h mirrored canary to validate KV cache behaviour after migration."
sam: Added that sentence to the migration guide and CHANGES.md: "Clarify Dedicated SLA preemption exclusion (add legal cross-ref); add tiny autoscale examples and Go SDK reservation snippet; fix handbook anchors."
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4832  labels: docs,dedicated,small. CI: docs-lint queued.
olivia: Linter + link-checker passed. One nit: change anchor /handbook/dedicated#isolation -> /handbook/dedicated#tenant-isolation; I pushed that fix.
docs-bot: CI passed  docs-lint, link-checker.
sam: Merged. Thanks! :tada:
leo: Can we follow up with a short Terraform example issue instead of bundling it here? I'll open.
sam: Thanks all. Closing thread.
